name: MeR – Fiskalizacija
author: productsmer

sections.description:
It is used to automatically create electronic invoices in the MeR system for Woocommerce orders.

External services

This plugin connects to an API to create electronic invoices.
This plugin allows users to select sandbox API URL-s for debugging purposes.

Sandbox URLs:
https://demo.moj-eracun.hr/apis/v2/send/ – for sending order data
https://demo.moj-eracun.hr/apis/v2/queryOutbox/” – for checking invoice status

Production URLs:
https://www.moj-eracun.hr/apis/v2/send/ – for sending order data
https://www.moj-eracun.hr/apis/v2/queryOutbox/” – for checking invoice status

It sends order information to service when Woocommerce order is completed or when an e-commerce admin manually decides to create new invoice.
This service is provided by “Elektronički računi d.o.o.”
terms of use: https://portal.moj-eracun.hr/uvjeti-poslovanja/
privacy policy: https://portal.moj-eracun.hr/izjava-o-zastiti-podataka/
